name: Rhino 8 education licence
summary: Full Rhino 3D modelling software at an education price for students, the same as the commercial version but not transferable.
key: US$195 for a single-user Rhino 8 education licence.
who: Students and educators buying an educational licence.
how: Buy from an Australian Rhino reseller.
catches: International prices may vary, so check the Australian reseller price.

evidence.quote: The educational versions are the same as the commercial versions, except that they are not transferable to another user.
